# RateEncodedSpikingVisualPlaceRecognition

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A method for visual place recognition where visual inputs are converted into spike rates and processed by a spiking neural network to identify locations. Enables energy-efficient, neuromorphic place recognition suitable for in-network edge devices in iNEST architectures.
